title: Unrefined aluminosilicate-based coagulants and sorbents for effective removal of phosphorus from wastewater: employment of natural halloysite nanostructures in the intensification of a multi-mechanism process
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,4665-4683
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00651A, Paper
